```python
script = '''
import fitz
import pytesseract
from PIL import Image
from markitdown import MarkItDown
import io
import sys

pdf_path = "uploads/handbook.pdf"

# --- Part 1: Extract text using MarkItDown ---
print("=" * 60)
print("PART 1: TEXT EXTRACTION (MarkItDown)")
print("=" * 60)
try:
    md = MarkItDown()
    result = md.convert(pdf_path)
    text_content = result.text_content
    # Print first 3000 chars to avoid flooding
    if len(text_content) > 3000:
        print(text_content[:3000])
        print(f"\\n... [truncated, total {len(text_content)} characters]")
    else:
        print(text_content)
except Exception as e:
    print(f"MarkItDown extraction error: {e}")

# --- Part 2: OCR on the first page image ---
print("\\n" + "=" * 60)
print("PART 2: OCR ON FIRST PAGE IMAGE (Tesseract)")
print("=" * 60)
try:
    doc = fitz.open(pdf_path)
    page = doc[0]
    # Render at 300 DPI for good OCR quality
    mat = fitz.Matrix(300/72, 300/72)
    pix = page.get_pixmap(matrix=mat)
    img_data = pix.tobytes("png")
    img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(img_data))
    # Save the first page image
    img.save("output/handbook_page1.png")
    print(f"First page rendered: {img.size[0]}x{img.size[1]} pixels, saved to output/handbook_page1.png")
    # Run OCR
    ocr_text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img)
    if len(ocr_text) > 3000:
        print(ocr_text[:3000])
        print(f"\\n... [truncated, total {len(ocr_text)} characters]")
    else:
        print(ocr_text)
    doc.close()
except Exception as e:
    print(f"OCR error: {e}")
'''
await write_file("./extract_pdf.py", script)
print("Script written.")

await run_command("mkdir -p output")

result = await run_command("python ./extract_pdf.py")
print(result)
```

```python
    ocr_text_final = "(OCR returned no text)" if ocr_fail else ocr_out.strip()

print(f"EXTRACTED TEXT: [{extracted_text}]")

print(r2c1)

safe_ext = extracted_text.replace("'", "").replace('"', '')
r2c2 = await run_command("python3 skills/OfficeBench/tools/excel/set_cell.py --file_path /workspace/testbed/data/handbook_results.xlsx --row_idx 2 --column_idx 2 --text '" + safe_ext + "'")

r3c1 = await run_command("python3 skills/OfficeBench/tools/excel/set_cell.py --file_path /workspace/testbed/data/handbook_results.xlsx --row_idx 3 --column_idx 1 --text 'OCR (First Page)'")

safe_ocr = ocr_text_final.replace("'", "").replace('"', '')
r3c2 = await run_command("python3 skills/OfficeBench/tools/excel/set_cell.py --file_path /workspace/testbed/data/handbook_results.xlsx --row_idx 3 --column_idx 2 --text '" + safe_ocr + "'")

verify = await run_command("python3 skills/OfficeBench/tools/excel/read_file.py --file_path /workspace/testbed/data/handbook_results.xlsx")
```
